source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique IB authcap identity; OOB transport remains separate.

source_snapshot.procedure: Raw 0x06 0x38 <channel> <privilege> by IB/OOB, then compare with ipmitool channel authcap; source also says clear logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command succeeds and decoded meaning matches channel authcap.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE / CHANGED with input validation, bitfield parser and normalized raw/high-level comparison.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Channel configuration cases are write operations and cannot be invoked here.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 readiness and ED-35 read-only scope apply.

original_test_intent: Read authentication capabilities for one BMC channel and requested privilege through IB, then prove raw fields and high-level output are semantically equivalent.
original_method: Use preserved raw 0x06/0x38 plus protected channel-authcap correlation with approved channel/privilege inputs and field normalization.
manual_activity: Engineer validates supported channel/privilege mapping and masks once; bounded reads then need no confirmation.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Overly conservative because source provides raw and high-level reads; schema remains a readiness input.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Bounded raw 0x06 0x38 plus protected channel authcap, compared structurally rather than textually.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Source channel/privilege placeholders and 10/5 timing preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate channel/privilege, decode completion/length/auth types/status/reserved bits, normalize channel-authcap and compare.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds input validation, parser and secure transport.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: IB remains required; no authentication-setting coverage claimed.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong channel or privilege can misstate platform security capabilities.

project_override_considerations: Alternate readers must expose equivalent per-channel/per-privilege fields; configuration APIs are not substitutes.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The raw command and semantic comparison align; missing channel choice and bit masks are Project readiness inputs, while unsafe wrappers are Review corrections.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read operation and correlation are defined and deterministic after inputs.

review_improvement: Makes raw-versus-high-level equivalence field-based and prevents an example channel from being treated as universal.
independent_technical_reasoning: Authentication-capability discovery is read-only and reproducible. Correct automation must validate target-specific channel/privilege and bitfields; it must not mutate authentication settings or equate textual formatting.
